VPRS — corrected-time order differs from finish order (spinnaker TCC)

VPRS is scored time-on-time, exactly like IRC: CT = ET × TCC, ranked by lowest corrected time. The TCCs here are real Dublin Bay SC 2026 spinnaker ratings (vprs.org). Gung-Ho (a slow Super Seal 26, TCC 0.855) crosses the line last but wins on handicap; Optique (a Cork 1720, TCC 1.003) is fastest on the water but only second on corrected time.

Scoring system: VPRS 
Start 14:00:00 (= 50400 s since midnight). Corrected times are rounded
half-up to whole seconds before ranking (matches HalSail/Sailwave).

Optique   ET 3498  CT = 3498 × 1.003 = 3508.49 → 3508  → 2nd (fastest elapsed)
Boomerang ET 3540  CT = 3540 × 0.992 = 3511.68 → 3512  → 3rd
Gung-Ho   ET 4090  CT = 4090 × 0.855 = 3496.95 → 3497  → 1st (slowest elapsed)
